c1.review: no CRITICAL/HIGH. MEDIUM M1 (consequence of the prescribed rate design, not a code defect): the i27 policies' Phi now moves in the visited states and ~62% of its total variation is faster than ~4 Hz (removed by a 0.25 s moving average); pay is gated (aim_gate) and capped while the charge is full, so this jitter nets a charge: per carry step ep300 -0.11 (gate loss 0.09 + cap loss 0.04; pay gate on rising steps 0.63 = grip_gate 0.80 x carry_both 0.87 x ...), ep600 -0.19, ep800 dodging carry -0.58 (grip_gate 0.39). Per episode (ep300) p50 -81 (p10 -153, p90 -26). It acts as a smoothness charge inside ~2 r of the mouth at ADR 0 (tremor weight is 0 there); after the first bead the latches switch it off. The approach pay is larger: the notes' stage numbers were computed as TILT_W * g * dPhi (cf.py), but the accumulated pay of a slow move is TILT_W * g * dPhi / DT = 60x that (e.g. lean into the pour plane ~+100, approach ~+90, tilt to the limit ~+51, to release ~+11 at the ep800 plateau gates), capped at 1 per step. LOW L1 (i27 L4 widened): d is rebuilt without the env 4 cm hold, so the source origin passing over the receiver mouth axis flips d and drops Phi in one step (charged in full, A11 <= 0; trace share of such steps 0%). LOW L2: the first-bead switch-off keeps the one-shot pay even if that bead spills; with reach 2 r it can be collected up to ~2 r off the mouth, but the spill charge (>= 12 per bead at n 10) and premature make the centred pour strictly better. LOW L3: the env records the lift reference at ANY carried moment with tilt < 20 deg (pour_fabric_env._grasp_frame, capture_grasp_ref), not only at the first 3 cm; a dodging policy regains posture by straightening once, with whatever grip it has then (change 3 then counts fingers off at that moment as lost). LOW L4 (i27 L1 kept): a finger counts as on at lift only above share 0.02

rule: gate PASS AND plan conformance (iter_27 terms kept, only the three notes_iter28 changes, KEEP rules, AST and component diff) AND user principles AND kuku-code-reviewer style review AND deterministic check of the changed rate term (derivative, closed cycles incl. gate toggles, lift-reference toggles, d flip and latch ramps, spout far, away/sideways/hold) AND sizing on the latest i27 trace states
warm_start: t2r_i27 ep300 (the checkpoint behind trace t2r_i27_ep300), not ep800/850 and not fresh (notes_iter28). Gate after 300 epochs (tensorboard + deterministic trace): diag/grip_src_ref_valid >= 0.8; source tilt at 3 cm lift p50 < 20 deg; out-of-plane lean at the tilt peak p50 < 15 deg; spout offset at the tilt peak p50 < 2 r; peak tilt toward the receiver p50 > 50 deg or a first bead in; receiver fingers on at lift >= 4.5 of 5 and receiver 5-finger carry >= 0.5. If the gate fails, restart fresh with iter_28
watch_first_trace: reward/tilt_rate starts negative (about -0.1/step at ep300 states); it must turn toward 0 or positive as the spout comes within 2 r. Failure sign: the spout offset or task/pour_lip_dist grows and aim falls (retreat from the Phi zone) instead of the jitter shrinking. Also diag/grip_src_ref_valid staying >= 0.8, posture_rcv (-0.14/step at the start) recovering through a fifth finger at lift, and no rise of cup_collision
